//: The versions formancy is tested with, and the one place they are written down.
CI reads each list as a job matrix, so every entry is a run; apps/docs/src/compatibility.test.ts
requires the lowest of each to be the lower bound of the range the packages declare, and the
compatibility page to state them. A range that widens without a run at its new bound fails
that test rather than becoming a claim (0134).
